name: Ajax Product Search for WooCommerce (Live + Instant + Fuzzy Search) – ProSearch
author: Ajax Search - ProSearch

sections.description:
ProSearch is a powerful Ajax Product Search plugin for WooCommerce that gives your store a fast, modern, and accurate WooCommerce product search experience.
It adds a beautifully designed live Ajax search bar that shows instant product results, suggestions, images, SKU, and prices while the customer types.

The default WooCommerce product search is limited. It doesn’t support live search, Ajax product search, SKU search, or fuzzy search.
ProSearch replaces the default search with an advanced Ajax Product Search engine built for speed, accuracy, and conversions.

With ProSearch, customers can quickly search products, search SKUs, search categories, search tags, and search attributes using our optimized index system. Even misspelled queries return accurate search results thanks to advanced fuzzy matching.

Whether your store has 100 or 100,000+ products, ProSearch ensures your customers enjoy fast, relevant, and intelligent search results every time.

Fully compatible with all major page builders and caching plugins, this plugin ensures lightning-fast product discovery on every device.

🔖 Shortcodes

✅ [mpsfw_search_form] — Display the AI-powered ajax product search form anywhere (pages, widgets, builders).

⚡ Main Features

⭐ Core Search Features

✅ Products Search: Perform fast, accurate product search across all WooCommerce products.
✅ Taxonomy Terms Search: Search product categories and search tags instantly with Ajax-powered results.
✅ Multiple Search Sources: Search in product title, search in content, search in excerpt, search in categories, search in tags, search in ID, and search in SKU — or enable only the sources you want.
✅ Smart Search Ordering: Product search results are automatically sorted based on relevance and keyword priority.
✅ Variable Product Search: Fully supports searching variable products and variation attributes.

⭐ Intelligent Search Accuracy

✅ Plural/ Singular Support: Search products correctly whether the customer types plural or singular forms.
✅ Synonym Search: Add custom synonym lists so multiple terms act the same during the ajax search process.
✅ Stop Words: Exclude irrelevant words from the search query for cleaner product search results.
✅ Misspelling Correction (Fuzzy Search): Automatically fix typos and spelling errors for accurate search matches.

⭐ Search Results Improvements

✅ Full Search Results Page Support: Integrates perfectly with your theme’s search results page.
✅ Live Ajax Search: Real-time Ajax search results appear instantly as users type.
✅ Fast Search Engine: Lightweight, optimized search engine with zero unnecessary load.

⭐ Visual Search Enhancements

✅ Widgets: Add the search widget anywhere to display the search bar.
✅ Shortcodes: Use shortcodes to display the search form, taxonomy term results, search suggestions, and related search terms.
✅ Product Image in Search: Show product images directly inside the search results.
✅ Product Price in Search: Display prices instantly in the search results dropdown.
✅ Product Description in Search: Include a short description in every search result.
✅ Product SKU Search Display: Show SKUs inside the search results for better product identification.
✅ Search Term Highlighting: Highlight the matched search keywords inside the results.
✅ Max Results Control: Choose how many search results appear in the dropdown.

⭐ Search Engine Automation

✅ Auto Sync: All product data is automatically synced, so your search index always stays fresh.
✅ Mobile Search Support: Mobile-optimized search layouts for seamless smartphone searching.
✅ Theme-Friendly Search: Works with almost every theme — your search interface blends perfectly.
✅ Diacritic Support: Search words with or without accents or special characters.

⭐ Analytics & Integrations

✅ Google Analytics Search Tracking: Track all user search queries inside your GA dashboard.
✅ Seamless Search Integration: Replace your current WooCommerce search with one click.
✅ Multilingual Search Support: Works with WPML, Polylang, WooCommerce Multilingual, qTranslate, GTranslate, etc.
✅ Page Builder Search Support: Fully compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, Breakdance, Bricks, Oxygen, Divi, Avada, and Flatsome for adding search bars anywhere.
✅ Built-in Integrations: Large library of integrations to extend search behavior, compatibility, and performance.

⚡ Advanced Search Cache Support

ProSearch is fully optimized to work seamlessly with all major WordPress and WooCommerce cache systems, ensuring your search performance stays fast, accurate, and reliable.

✅ Search-Safe Caching – Every search query is handled through a cache-compatible architecture that prevents stale or outdated search results.
✅ Dynamic Search Cache Bypass – Live Ajax product search requests automatically bypass page cache, ensuring real-time search results even on heavily cached websites.
✅ Optimized Search Indexing – The search index interacts safely with caching layers, so search requests stay instant while ensuring your product search data is always up to date.
✅ Zero Cache Conflicts – No double-caching, no blocked results, no broken search — everything is built for clean, accurate, and stable search behavior.

With ProSearch, you get powerful search caching compatibility that keeps your store fast, stable, and perfectly optimized — regardless of your caching plugin.

⚙️ Product Index Table Search Technology

✅ Dedicated Search Index Table – Stores all product data inside a high-performance search-optimized index table, improving search speed, search accuracy, and overall product search performance.
✅ Auto Search Sync – Automatically syncs and updates the product search index whenever products are added, edited, or deleted, ensuring every search query returns fresh, reliable, and real-time search results.
✅ Advanced Smart Search Relevance Engine – Uses intelligent search scoring to prioritize product titles, SKUs, categories, tags, and attributes for the most relevant WooCommerce search results.
✅ Scalable Search Architecture – Designed to deliver consistent search performance and stable search behavior for WooCommerce stores of all sizes, from small catalogs to large enterprise-level search environments.
✅ Manual Search Index Rebuild Option – Allows you to manually rebuild the entire search index table anytime for improved search precision, stronger search relevance, and maximum search reliability.
✅ Blazing-Fast Search Queries – Engineered for lightning-fast search processing, delivering instant product search results, rapid live search suggestions, and ultra-responsive search requests even on catalogs with 100,000+ products.

💡 User Experience Enhancements

✅ Highlights matched search keywords in search results
✅ Option to set maximum number of search results
✅ Replace default WooCommerce search bar seamlessly
✅ Fully optimized mobile search layout, ensuring smooth and responsive product search on all devices.
✅ Clean, user-friendly search interactions designed to improve search engagement and increase conversions.

🌐 Multilingual Search Compatibility

✅ Fully compatible with WPML, Polylang, WooCommerce Multilingual, qTranslate, and GTranslate, ensuring your product search engine works seamlessly across all languages.
✅ Multilingual search indexing for accurate and consistent search results in every supported language.
✅ Perfect for global stores needing reliable international search performance.

🧱 Admin Search Controls

✅ Clean and intuitive search settings panel for managing all product search options.
✅ Manual search index rebuild control to refresh and optimize your product search database anytime.
✅ Choose which product data appears in search results — image, title, price, SKU, description, and more.

✅ Developer-friendly structure for extending or customizing search behavior, search layouts, and search performance.

🧠 Why Choose ProSearch

✅ Powered by an advanced AI Search Engine + Product Search Index Table for the fastest, most accurate WooCommerce product search experience.
✅ Faster than the default WooCommerce search, delivering instant live search results and real-time product search suggestions.
✅ Highly accurate search matching with context-aware search logic, fuzzy search corrections, typo-tolerant search, and smart search relevance scoring.
✅ Works perfectly with Elementor and all major page builders, allowing you to place your search bar and search widgets anywhere.
✅ Designed for high-performance search, scalable search operations, and stable search behavior across small and large WooCommerce stores.
✅ Lightweight, fully responsive, and optimized for mobile search, ensuring fast product search results across all devices.

🚀 Coming Soon (Pro Features)

✅ Advanced AI Training – Train the engine with your own store data for more personalized results.
✅ Search Analytics Dashboard – Gain insights into what customers are searching for and optimize your store accordingly.
✅ Multivendor Compatibility – Full support for popular multivendor plugins to ensure accurate results across vendor products.
✅ Custom Field Support – Include ACF, Meta Fields, and custom product fields in your search indexing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ProSearch settings to configure search options.
  4. Add the shortcode or Elementor, Divi widget anywhere on your site.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace the default WooCommerce search?

Yes. ProSearch upgrades or replaces the default WooCommerce search with a fast, AI-enhanced
Ajax product search that delivers instant and highly relevant results.

How does the Product Index Table work?

ProSearch creates a dedicated index table that stores product titles, SKUs, categories, tags,
attributes, and meta fields. This structure ensures lightning-fast search queries even for large
WooCommerce stores.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The optimized index table and smart caching ensure that search queries are handled instantly
while keeping server load extremely low.

Is ProSearch compatible with Elementor, Divi, or other builders?

Yes. ProSearch includes a native Elementor widget and works smoothly with Divi, Bricks,
Beaver Builder, Gutenberg, WPBakery, Oxygen, and all major theme builders.

Can I show the search bar anywhere?

Yes. You can place the search bar using the shortcode [mpsfw_search_form] or use the page-builder
widgets included with the plugin.

Do I need to rebuild the index manually?

No. The index updates automatically when products are added, edited, or deleted. A manual rebuild
option is available for full control.

Is ProSearch compatible with multilingual websites?

Yes. It works with WPML, Polylang, WooCommerce Multilingual, qTranslate, and other translation plugins.

Does it support variable and attribute-based products?

Yes. Variations, attributes, and complex product data are indexed automatically for accurate results.

Is this plugin better than FiboSearch or the default WooCommerce search?

ProSearch includes features such as AI relevance scoring, fuzzy matching, and an optimized index
table that work differently from the default WooCommerce search and other search plugins like
FiboSearch. Actual performance depends on your store’s data, size, and configuration.

Does ProSearch work on websites with large product catalogs?

Yes. The search engine is designed to handle large WooCommerce stores with 50,000–100,000+ products
while keeping searches fast and accurate.
